items.title:
Open all windows and garage doors, monkey has the key!
• Keep windows behind the 20's closed if experiencing windy weather

Set up upper deck outside:
• 2 two-tops to create 17 & 18            • 1 four-top to create table 19

Set up upper deck inside:
• 3 two-tops along the green bench to create tables 21-23.            
• 1 four-top on the opposite side to create table 24.

Set up barstools on the outside of K-bar, being mindful of spacing.
Wipe down hand rails surronding the 20's.

Slide plants onto the corners of the windows at 11, 13, 14, and 16.
Make sure plants are not pressed up agains the brick wall or in the walk way.
Place all red chairs at the tables. Bring down brown chairs on table 32 and set up.

Check stock on the following items: mats, bar towels, polishing towels, to go supplies, toilet paper, handsoap, napkins, candle oil & trash can liners. Make a list of what you need, and head down to P3 Storage to grab anything needed to get us through the entire shift.

proof.prompt: The list of what's low and needs to be pulled from P3 storage

items.title:
Set up server station with a folded white towels &  polishing towels.
• Large Runner mat at expo window
• 3'x5' mats at entrance to kitchen and entrance to K-bar

Set up sanitizer bottles and towels on the server credenza. Sani bottles should be refilled daily before service, validated using sani test strips to be between 250 - 400ppm, and labeled to include date and time.                                                            Set up Beech bar, K-bar and host stand with 1 bottle and 1 towel.

proof.prompt: The sani bottles filled, labeled with date and time, and strip-tested to 250-400ppm

items.title:
Wipe down all tables.
• Use santizer-soaked rag for all tables.
• Use couch brush (located in bottome drawer of host stand) for the couch (40's) and wipe the bases of these tables with the other brush

Fill and reset all lanterns in place. Make sure the wick is in place to light when it's time.
• 1 small lantern on 17-19, 21-26, 41-45 • 1 large "hurricane" lamp on 32 & 33
• 3 trollers on Beech Bar • 2 large trollers on Party Bar.

proof.prompt: The lanterns filled and reset in place across the floor and bars

items.title: Check that tables are level. Use wobble wedges if needed. Tables in the 40s, as well as the feet of the tables on the upper deck, have adjustable knobs on the bottom to help level out.

Make sure backup silverware is polished and sorted.
Restock expo line with Large spoons, Small spoons, caviar spoons, gold spoons
Clean/polish glass all tables every day- degreaser and a rag does the trick
Place all barmats down in at the water station and set up water glasses and bottles.  Fill about 10 water bottles to start.

Re-stock restrooms with toilet paper, seat covers, and soap.
Place black mats down in each restroom.
Detail both restrooms' neon signs

proof.prompt: Both restrooms restocked with paper, seat covers and soap, mats down, neon signs detailed

items.title: Roll the awnings out
Walk through the dining room with leaf blower and make sure the floor is clear of debris, especially under tables. Use microfiber mop to clean underneath fireplace banquettes (11 - 16).
Walk down Beech St. and check the streetside for any obstructions, messes, or garbage left outside our space (planter boxes, brick sign.. etc)
Turn on Slushy Machine
Using Saddle Soap, I thoroughly cleaned / buffed all leather-topped tables (41 - 45)

proof.prompt: The leather-topped tables (41-45) cleaned and buffed

items.title: Using the shop vac or stiff bristled couch brush, I cleaned out all nooks / crannies on the sofa / booth seats (41 - 45)
Use Glass cleaner to wipe all mirrors
Check Toast for 86 items, new beers, menu item counts, and technical issues, etc. Make sure banks have been put out in the drawers (check with lead)
Reference Ctuit and write down current roster on the white board.

Walk thru of space to check additional needs.
Check in with manager, chef, and bartender to see if anything else needs to be done prior to opening.

Make sure all dirty silverware/ramekins are brought back to the dish pit.
Ask dishwasher to run through.
Polish all silverware/ramekins and sort accordingly.

Wipe down all terminals in service station and all counter surfaces.
Remove all water bottles and personal belongings from station.

Break down water station, Send empty carafes to the bar to run through the dishwasher.
Bring bottles and glassware to the corner of the counter and wrap bottles with plastic.

Clean both server/POS stations, the entire surface wiped down, countertop organized
Drawers and cabinets below should be restocked and organized.
(To go items, wet naps, thermal paper)

proof.prompt: Both server/POS stations wiped down and the drawers below restocked and organized

items.title: Run service trays and beverage mats through the dishwasher and place back on service rack

Refill all sanitizer spray bottles and consolidate on table 33.
Remove all lanters from tables/bars and consolidate on table 33.
Double check the lantern on the mantle - put the fire out.
Polish lanterns and clean bulbs.

proof.prompt: Sani bottles refilled and all lanterns consolidated on table 33, fires out

items.title:
Fill and reset all lanterns in place. Make sure the wick is in place to light when it's time.
• 1 small lantern on 17-19, 21-26, 41-45 • 1 large "hurricane" lamp on 32 & 33
• 3 trollers on Beech Bar • 2 large trollers on Party Bar.
Every 2 weeks, on prescribed day, empty SS machine, clean all surfaces / behind / under
Return iPads to the electrical room and charge

Empty out all trash and make a trash run to P1.
• Make sure all empty boxes from the back hallway are brought down
• Make sure all towels are brought down
• Make sure all broken glass and bottles are brought down
• Used floor mats go downstairs per schedule on the white board
Wipe down all tables throughout the restaurant
Wipe down the Ice cream machine and turn night mode on.

Return all menus to the host stand.
Make sure phone is charging

Complete checkout and cash owed slips and hand to MOD.
(make sure money is faced and organized!)

Return iPads to the electrical room and charge
Pause music and yelp reviews.
Place chairs at 32 above the table. Stack all red chairs.
Wipe down brass and wood ledge adjacent to T26

Slide plants between fire tables.
Bring in tables 17-19.
Close all windows. Roll the awnings back up.

Do a final check at the dishpit for silverware/ramekins.
Polish, restock and wrap with plastic.

Return the monkey to the host stand.
Turn off the lamp at the server station.
Wipe down the marble on entire pass/wipe under all equipment

proof.prompt: The marble pass wiped down and wiped clean under all equipment

items.title: Turn Slushy Machine to drip mode
Scrub under shelves at pass, detail glass and black metal glass framing above pass

proof.prompt: Under the shelves at the pass scrubbed, and the glass and black metal framing above the pass detailed

items.title: Make sure K bar is set up for weekend service - rails fully stocked, caddys full, squeeze bottles filled, wells have full tool setup, and ensure k is set up for smooth open
Turn off fans, wrap cord, and put them away in server station
Note any wack closing but be nice about it
Go through liquor cabinet, beer cans, and ALL wines, make sure it was stocked

items.title: Bag & place trash bins in their appropriate spots, and milk crates at each well

Make sure dehydrated fruit garnishes are stocked - lime wheels, lemon wheels, orange slices
Set up salt, Tajín, and sugar for each well
Set out zesting fruit [2 grapefruit 4-5 lemons and oranges each well].

Put out cocktail batches, sweet vermouth, dry vermouth, buff cream, spro mod
Put out juices/syrups for speed rail [lemon lime simple OJ pinapple] ALWAYS CHECK QUALITY, dump any citrus thats over 3 days old

items.title: Place cheater caddies at each well
Pull out squeeze bottle syrups - check quality ALWAYS
Pull out perishable garnishes from low boi [cherries, olives, dahlia, orchids, mint, berries, rosemary, cilantro]

Check quality of backup garnish delis in fridge - if lime wheels, orange slices are going bad put in dehydrator instead of tossing.
Turn on slushie machine (ensure it's at level 6)
Ice wells 30-45 min before service
Fill KD ice at the bottom of garnish caddie topped with pebble ice

items.title: Put soda water in mixing spoon glasses

Check dishwasher fluids, replace if empty

Burn dat Ice.
